_comment: Hand-curated model families (no metrics). Files are assigned to a family by the FIRST matching 'patterns' regex on their repo-relative path (backup files: path relative to aerotrack_server/source/ or aerotrack_server/). Named groups: run, tag, seed. Add a family here to make a new kind of model discoverable; run scripts/build_workspace_registry.py afterwards.

families.name: AeroTrack detector, CST-only training (X1 / X2 series)
families.architecture: YOLO11n as-built (stride layout, c3k=True erratum), 9-channel temporal window, ~2.6 M params
families.input_contract: IR video frames (CST 640x512), window per run_meta.json (causal [t, t-4, t-8] / ttt = single frame), letterbox 640
families.output_contract: per frame: STE box xyxy (px) or absent, mode (init/track/coast/reacquired/absent), associated detection score; raw detections
families.preprocessing: letterbox 640x640 (aspect kept), 3 frames stacked to 9 channels, per experiments/deployment/scripts/aerotrack_stream.py
families.training_data: CST train (120 seq, corpus v2 data_unified_v2)
families.selection_policy: last.pt fixed before any run (fitness-selected best.pt is not used)

families.name: AeroTrack detector, standard YOLO11n layout (registered experiment F1)
families.architecture: standard YOLO11n (src/model/yolo11-stride-std.yaml, 89.8 % COCO load), causal_g4 window

families.name: AeroTrack detector, v2 campaign (temporal windows on corpus v2)
families.architecture: YOLO11n as-built, 9-channel window stock(ttt) / sym_g4 / causal_g{1,2,4,8}
families.input_contract: IR / RGB frames; window per run_meta.json
families.verdict: causal_g4 selected (v2_decisions.md); v2_causal_g4_s0_e20 last.pt = CF detector

families.name: AeroTrack detector, generalization series (grouped DEV folds)
families.architecture: YOLO11n as-built; stock / SPD-Conv / temporal g1 / g4 (symmetric window)
families.input_contract: frames; window per run_meta.json (symmetric needs g future frames)
families.training_data: corpus v1 (truncated CST) DEV folds / full
families.verdict: g=4 temporal supported, SPD-Conv not (GEN_REPORT.md); gen_temporal_fp_g4_full_e20 was the selected detector before v2

families.name: AeroTrack detector, repair ablation grid (initialisation-confounded)
families.architecture: YOLO11n as-built variants (SPD / no-SPD / single frame / stock)
families.verdict: verdicts overturned by the generalization series (init confound)

families.name: AeroTrack deployment exports (ONNX / TensorRT) and deployment package
families.framework: ONNX Runtime 1.30 / TensorRT 11.3 (engines are GPU- and version-specific)

families.name: Track C learned trajectory forecaster, pooled (C1)
families.architecture: mlp / gru / tfm history encoder + per-horizon diagonal Gaussian head (L=16 history, H=24 future)
families.input_contract: track history of 16 frames (visibility, displacement, log size ratio) + global features
families.training_data: Track C TRAIN trajectories (Anti-UAV IR/RGB + CST), oracle histories
families.verdict: C1: learned beats classical on Anti-UAV; not on CST (TRACK_C_SUMMARY.md)

families.name: Track C learned forecaster, domain-aware (C1c: domtok / perdom)
families.architecture: tfm encoder + Gaussian head; domtok = pooled with camera token, perdom = one model per domain
families.input_contract: as aerotrack.forecaster.c1 (+ domain token for domtok)
families.verdict: H1c NOT_SUPPORTED: removes CST negative transfer but does not beat classical dcv

families.name: LSTM forecaster (Review 2, retired)
families.verdict: RETIRED: collapsed / loses to classical baselines (docs/AEROTRACK_REPAIR_REPORT.md)

families.name: GlobalTrack fine-tuned on Anti-UAV (normal / DFSC), paper reproduction
families.input_contract: Anti-UAV IR (640x512) or RGB (1920x1080) frames + frame-0 GT box
families.output_contract: per frame box xywh (px) + score; never reports absence
families.preprocessing: TestTransform(scale, pad_divisor) from the run's config.effective.yaml
families.training_data: Anti-UAV train (160 seq) of the run's modality

families.name: GlobalTrack official pretrained weights (converted to torchvision layout)

v3_n__causal_g4_cst_s0_e20@last.role: X1 (STE + argmax; single registered CST TEST pass PBS 93019) AND X2 temporal causal_g4 seed 0 (PBS 93029) -- one checkpoint, two registered roles

v2_causal_g4_s0_e20@last.role: CF final-system detector (frozen_cf.json, CF-A2) and v2 selected arm causal_g4 seed 0

gen_temporal_fp_g4_full_e20@last.role: selected detector of the generalization series; TEST spent once (gen ledger)

normal_ir@last.role: Protocol II IR, plain fine-tuning (alpha 0), seed 0; TEST spent (ledger lines 1-2)

dfsc_ir@last.role: Protocol II IR, DFSC (alpha 1), seed 0; TEST spent (ledger lines 5-6)

phaseB_normal_ir_seed1@last.role: seed-1 replication; TEST run 2026-09-23 outside the then-authorised scope (supplementary)

phaseB_dfsc_ir_ism_cross@last.role: DFSC-all ablation: TEST evaluation incomplete (54/91 sequences) -- NO VALID RESULT; never score the partial files

normal_rgb@last.role: A2 visible-modality plain fine-tuning (TEST evaluated, A2 registration)

largescale_globaltrack@last.role: paper's 'large-scale' row: GlobalTrack without Anti-UAV fine-tuning (zero-shot, converted official weights)

v2_causal_g4_s0_e2_smoke@last.role: 2-epoch plumbing smoke run -- not a model

v2_causal_g4_s0_e2_smoke@best.role: 2-epoch plumbing smoke run -- not a model
